general.phygitalDescription1: Bring the digital soul into the physical product.
general.phygitalDescription2: The Nomion Comprehensive Technology Solution provides software and equipment that support and identify the physical product and create an authenticated version of the NFT using blockchain technology.
general.physicalToDigital: Initiating the physical world into the digital space
general.phygitalSolution: Phygital - The solution for initiating the physical world into the digital space
general.phygitalGenerate: Generate unprecedented value in the digital space via real-world assets
general.fourTypeOfData: There are 4 types of data needed to transition to create a parallel world (multiverse)
general.ourBeliefDescription: Nowadays, our world is gradually shifting towards the digital space. We believe that the physical world itself contains many barriers, while the digital world cannot survive alone.
general.ourBeliefQuote: The Phygital world is the convergence of two parallel spaces to overcome physical barriers and thrive for sustainability.
general.ourClientsDescription: By integrating products and activities from the physical world into the digital space, Phygital Labs help elevate the value of Vietnamese brands and product
general.digitalIdentityDescription: The digital identity solution helps with the digital identification of physical products in the digital space, opening up an interaction space without limitations from borders or distance.
general.digitalActivitiesDescription: The technology platform that helps elevate the process of organizing, participating and tracking sporting events, creating a seamless and holistic experience for users between the physical and digital platforms.

story.fact1: Vietnam is the second-largest coffee exporter globally
story.fact2: Coffee cultivation area is about approximately 600,000 hectares
story.fact3: Within this vast expanse, Robusta dominates, covering around 93% of the cultivated land, while Arabica and Liberica combined account for the remaining 7%.
story.fact4: Spanning over 10 hectares, the farm cultivates various coffee varieties such as Catimor, TH1, THA1, and Yellow Catuai, specifically catering to both domestic and international markets with Specialty-grade standards. The coffee at Radar Farm benefits from a semi-organic fertilization approach, implemented beneath the protective canopy of pine forests. Moreover, the farm employs advanced processing techniques that enable precise and synchronized control over the fermentation process.
